🎬 Workin’ Moms (2017–2023)

Workin’ Moms follows four women living in Toronto as they navigate the hilarious, exhausting, and often unpredictable challenges of balancing motherhood, careers, relationships, and personal ambitions. At the center of the story is Kate Foster, a successful public relations executive who struggles to adjust to life after maternity leave while trying to maintain her demanding career and responsibilities as a mother. Alongside her are Anne Carlson, a straightforward psychiatrist dealing with complicated family issues, Frankie Coyne, a real estate agent facing emotional struggles, and Jenny Matthews, a young mother questioning her identity and marriage. Connected through a parenting support group, the women develop friendships while confronting the pressures and expectations placed on working mothers. From chaotic mornings and embarrassing workplace situations to marriage problems, parenting disagreements, career setbacks, and unexpected romantic complications, their lives are filled with moments that are both hilarious and deeply relatable. As they pursue professional success and personal happiness, each woman discovers that motherhood rarely follows a perfect plan. Through difficult decisions, emotional setbacks, and surprising moments of growth, their friendships become an important source of support. Combining sharp comedy, heartfelt drama, bold humor, and realistic storytelling, the series explores motherhood, friendship, ambition, marriage, identity, and the challenges of finding balance in modern family life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 22–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Catherine Reitman

source_details.synopsis: Workin' Moms is a Canadian television comedy-drama sitcom series that premiered on CBC Television on January 10, 2017. The show stars Catherine Reitman, Jessalyn Wanlim, Dani Kind, Enuka Okuma, and Juno Rinaldi as a group of friends dealing with the challenges of being working mothers. The series is produced by Wolf + Rabbit Entertainment, the production company of Reitman and her husband, Philip Sternberg. In February 2019, in the middle of season 3, the series premiered globally on Netflix. On May 29, 2019, Workin' Moms was renewed for a fourth season, which premiered on February 18, 2020.
